stage: Supplementary stress test, fixed after main results
stress_attack: On the primary cell, optimize final-rule target margins over fractional reward amplitudes on multiple fixed edit allocations: each method's worst binary witness, upward greedy allocations for each candidate, and four random allocations. Each allocation uses at most k edits; amplitudes vary in [0,1]. Differential evolution targets the bad candidates and fallback. This is a restricted continuous search, not a global continuous optimum.
stronger_analytic_check: For corrected centered DR compute L_j^all = clean nominal score_j - C_(2k,j)(clean log), a simultaneous lower envelope over every <=k real-valued attack. For all candidates, the attacked corrected score_j is <= clean nominal score_j. If the lower envelope for a candidate of value at least v beats zero and the upper scores of every lower-value candidate, then every real-valued attack selects a policy worth at least v on this realized log. Report the frequency and values of these deterministic certificates.
execution_note: The full real-valued envelope was proved and audited. It rules out harmful selection for every allowed attack on all primary logs, and yields a worst-value lower bound. This supersedes the proposed restricted differential-evolution stress search, which was not run. In addition, 500 random fractional witnesses verified the implementation.
